content.short: zkSwap Finance is the first Swap-to-Earn DeFi platform on the zkSync Era ecosystem.
content.description: zkSwap Finance employs an incentive-driven approach that rewards both liquidity providers and traders. At its core is the Swap2Earn model, which records and distributes $ZF tokens for every swap during active Swap2Earn cycles. This design links rewards directly to on-chain activity, encouraging ongoing participation, stronger liquidity, and more efficient swaps across compatible networks. By embedding earnings into the swap experience, zkSwap Finance aims to boost user engagement and create a dynamic, rewarding environment for all participants in the ecosystem.
